Restaurant Partner Onboarding

Keep Pickup. Add LCS Delivery.

Connect your restaurant's Square account to Courier Eats so eligible delivery orders can be handed to Lewiston Courier Service while your normal restaurant pickup workflow stays in place.

0% COMMISSION Keep 100% of your menu sales. Courier Eats does not take a percentage of your food sales.
PLATFORM Get listed on the Courier Eats platform with ordering and delivery access designed for local restaurants.
CASH APP Use Cash App as an additional customer payment or business-payment option where appropriate for your restaurant workflow.
SOCIAL MEDIA Courier Eats can help feature participating restaurants across social media and local promotional channels.
PICKUP Stays with your restaurant. Courier Eats does not create an LCS dispatch for pickup orders.
DELIVERY After delivery is configured for your own courier workflow, eligible Square delivery orders can be sent to Lewiston Courier Service for dispatch.

Connect Restaurant

Join Courier Eats

Enter the restaurant name exactly as you want it shown in Courier Eats, then continue to Square.

Restaurant-first model: keep 100% of your menu sales with 0% Courier Eats commission. Standard payment-processing charges and any separately agreed delivery/service fees are not commissions. You stay in control of your Square account, Pickup remains unchanged, and Square will show the permissions requested before you approve access.
